change-figure.purpose: The dollar change in the headline only. 72px at 760px and under.

headline.purpose: First line of the h1; 26px on phones.

section-title.purpose: Page sections at 31px, the cause and check columns at 27px.

action-figure.purpose: Program amounts on action cards; 32px on secondary cards.

amount.purpose: The two bill totals in the lead; cause amounts use 23px.

body.purpose: Running text, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next with digits from WSH Figures; 17px under 760px.

body-small.purpose: Captions, sources, kWh lines, check text. The floor for readable text.

chart-label.purpose: Weather chart labels, y-axis and the phone running-total chart only.

code.purpose: SQL blocks and inline identifiers in the evidence area only.

fontFaces.declaration: @font-face{font-family:"WSH Figures"; src:url("/fonts/public-sans-latin.woff2") format("woff2"); font-weight:400 800; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; unicode-range:U+0030-0039; size-adjust:92%}
fontFaces.purpose: Public Sans digits inside Atkinson Hyperlegible Next sentences, scaled with size-adjust 92% to Atkinson's cap height.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: --shadow is none; the system is flat. The only box-shadow in the build is an inset underline on the live comparison column header: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--service).

focus.note: Heat Ink as the focus color is recorded as built; it sits outside the direction contract's temperature rule.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing in the build, for entrances and state transitions.

motion.name: block-rise
motion.value: rise 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), delay block index x 60ms
motion.purpose: Page blocks enter with opacity and a 6px lift.

motion.name: row-rise
motion.value: rise 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), delay 200ms + row index x 30ms, index capped at 7

motion.name: segment-grow
motion.value: scaleX 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), delay 260ms + row index x 70ms

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.value: scaleY 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), delay 240ms + day index x 4ms
motion.purpose: Weather bars, growing from the bottom.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press transforms: buttons scale(.97), thumbnail scale(.98).

motion.name: switch-and-caret
motion.purpose: Switch knob and track, evidence caret rotation.

motion.name: chart-shading
motion.purpose: Bill shading opacity and bracket color on the weather chart.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Turns off every animation and transition; the script also scrolls to the chart without smoothing.

drift: Sample-data label in the shell uses Heat at 22% with a warm border: a temperature color outside weather and money. Not canonized.
Failure card warning icon uses Reject Ink outside the checker's rejection. Not canonized.
--reject is declared but used only as a literal copy at 55% opacity on the rejected check border.
--shadow is declared as none and never referenced.
Change figure is 108px on wide screens; the direction contract asked for 76 to 88px.
Weather strip sits before the cause table; the direction contract put it after the cause table and checks.
Section headings are Ink; service blue reaches sections only through icons and marks.

narrative.overview:
The page reads like a weather service's daily report for Columbus. A full-bleed service-blue bar carries the brand and the two bill tabs; under it, on a cool pale ground, the change in the bill is set at forecast-headline scale, and the real daily temperatures of both billing periods run as a chart of one bar per day. Everything else is set as plain report furniture: ruled lists, a few bordered boxes, tabular figures, and short sentences for a reader of 71 with the paper bill beside her.

Density is moderate and calm. Running text is 18px (17px on phones) and never drops below 16px; only chart labels go to 14px. Colors are few and each has a job: service blue for the shell and the system's marks, a warm/cool pair for the direction of money, a six-step temperature scale for the weather bars, and one red for the checker's rejection. Surfaces are flat: there are no shadows.

This file was written from the shipped build of `web/index.html` (styles in `web/src/styles.css`, markup in `web/src/view.ts`) on 25 Oct 2026. It replaces the 22 Oct record of an earlier direction (the ticket wallet); none of that system is in the build. The earlier files are kept in `.impeccable/` as `DESIGN.superseded-2026-10-22.md` and `design.superseded-2026-10-22.json`. The rendered page was not inspected for this record; where a claim depends on the render, it says so.
keyCharacteristics: Service-blue shell over a cool pale ground; one 4px corner radius for every box.
Public Sans for headings and figures, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for sentences, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono only for SQL and identifiers.
Digits inside sentences come from a self-hosted Public Sans subset ("WSH Figures"), so no slashed zero reaches the reader.
The weather strip, one bar per day colored by that day's average temperature, is the signature component.
Flat surfaces: 1px borders and ruled lines, no shadows.
Phosphor Light icons on causes, agents, checks, actions, evidence rows and states.
Agents carry plain names on screen; code names appear only in the evidence area.

rules.name: The Weather Owns The Scale Rule
rules.body: The six temperature steps color weather bars and their legend, nothing else. Money uses Heat and Cold, which are separate tokens.

rules.name: The Direction Has A Temperature Rule
rules.body: Added money is warm, money taken off is cool, and the change figure itself stays Ink; only its arrow takes the color. Every colored amount also carries a sign and a verb (Added, Took off, No change, Nothing left), so color is never the only signal.

rules.name: The One Rejection Rule
rules.body: Rejection red marks the checker's rejection and nothing else.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: Running text is never below 16px. Chart labels are the only text at 14px.

rules.name: The Figures Are Public Sans Rule
rules.body: Headings and every figure, standalone or inside a sentence, are Public Sans. Sentences are Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.

rules.name: The Mono Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono appears only in SQL blocks and inline identifiers (table names, station id, rate label, run id, model name, agent code names), all inside the evidence area.

rules.name: The Box Or Rule Rule
rules.body: A box (1px border, no shadow) holds one thing read or used as a whole: the weather chart, the cause table, an action card, the notes. Lists are ruled lines: checks, the not-offered list, evidence rows.
